reason: Conditional requirement: when a Copilot agent works on the repo, the listed unit tests must be executed.
Orders the reader to stop under three conditions (i.e. not to continue then); the last clause allows a no-change report.
Tells the reader to scan the checks and reject only on real problems, and not to merge while checks are still running.
Schema changes only through migrations; never edit an applied migration; add a new one.
Prohibits adding open-ended directives without a concrete, task-specific reason.
Requires new features/changes to be described clearly and allows a generic line only for the listed cases.
Names a pitfall and describes how service accounts end up over-provisioned; 'never trimmed' is descriptive.
Requires an already-absorbing member to be chosen as primary and forbids merging two such members.
Mostly describes a migration gap, but 'they have to be rebuilt' places a requirement on whoever migrates.
Direct prohibition: never use this directly.
A section heading; 'avoid' is part of the title.
Requires presigned URLs for client uploads and forbids proxying large files through the API.
Requires generating then reviewing/trimming the config; 'the file must not already exist' limits when generation may run.

Conditional instruction: if a step cannot be described concretely, read more.
Forbids proceeding until the source repo context is resolved.
Requires the agent to stay in task-request mode whenever it is not executing tasks.
Requires test names to be valid Rust identifiers by replacing '-' with '_'.
Requires creating the label first and forbids creating milestones or types without asking.
Requires keeping the database under the user config dir and forbids putting it next to the executable.
Tells the reader to use remote functions and define them in .remote.ts files; 'always run on the server' describes them.
Requires writing, approving and A/B-testing the pretext, all before any target receives it.
A noun phrase naming an activity; on its own it tells no one to do or not do anything.
Forbids pasting logs, tokens or payloads into shared tickets and requires redacting request bodies first.
States Blue Ocean is deprecated and forbids building new workflows around it.
Requires copying images with the same relative paths when the source has them.
Mostly describes where rustup puts files, but 'which must be on PATH' requires the reader to ensure that.
Prohibits deferring glossary edits to a later batch.

Forbids reporting such a run as fully covered and requires pointing at the ledger file.
A list item naming a deliverable; '(always achievable)' describes it.
A bare label introducing a list; by itself it gives no instruction.
Requires test names to be readable as standalone sentences.
Prescribes reactive() for objects, forbids destructuring it directly, and requires toRefs()/toRef().
Forbids exposing private keys in frontend code and requires wallet providers for user wallets.
Forbids proceeding until resolved.
Conditional prohibition on asking for more scope inputs unless a failing command requires it.
Requires scoping every query to the user's resource group or subscription, which restricts query breadth.
A checklist rule requiring background images at depth-0 with slight blur.
Lead-in requiring the (listed) steps every time and placing them before any change is made.
Requires reporting XSS through responsible disclosure and forbids public reporting.
Tells the agent not to wait when the user asks it to wait for review.
Requires literal, systematic execution and rules out human interpretation or clarification.
Requires recomputing baselines after the (listed) events.
Requires checking for existing modules, which must happen before creating new resources.
Tells the reader to avoid brittle tests and not rely on timestamps, random data or order unless necessary.
Describes the workflow's behaviour; 'never commits' is descriptive.
Forbids passing secrets as literals and requires keeping unmasked output out of CI logs.
Tells the reader to avoid large client bundles and keep most logic in Server Components.

Requires bounding every regex quantifier and forbids the unbounded form.
Forbids marking one resolved on the agent's own judgement.
Requires storing the challenge server-side and forbids trusting one sent back by the client.
Labelled directive forbidding automatic termination and ending sessions.
Requires reading the marked paragraphs before flagging, which gates flagging; 'do not report' is only a paragraph label.
Reports an eval measurement; 'never' describes the result without the plugin.
Forbids modules from using git references.
Describes what the file holds; no directive in the statement itself.
A paper title and summary; 'must be false' is part of the title.
Requires pinning versions and committing lockfiles when installing Supabase packages.
Requires adding delays between navigations; 'to avoid ...' gives the reason, not a separate prohibition.

Requires keeping MongoDB unpublished and forbids adding a public ports entry for it or Meilisearch.

Table row mapping a PR state to an action (offer a review subagent); 'Never reviewed' is the category name.

Requires providing the symbol name.

Requires async/await or Promises for waiting on session events.
